mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_config (config_name, config_type, config_title_one, config_title_two, config_data) VALUES (#{param.configName}, #{param.configType}, #{param.configTitleOne}, #{param.configTitleTwo}, #{param.configData});
mapper.select: select pc.id, pc.config_name, pc.config_title_one, pc.config_title_two, pc.config_data from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_config pc

SELECT gp.name as name, gp.person_num as personNum, gp.common_id as commonId, gd.price_ori as priceOri, gd.price as price, gc.common_image as commonImage, gc.common_name as commonName, gd.goods_id as goodsId, gp.start_time as startTime, gp.end_time as endTime, status, gc.goods_type as goodsType, gc.shop_id as shopId FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail gd ON gp.pintuan_id = gd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gp.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE 1 = 1 and gp.common_id = #{commonId} and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.is_delete = 0 group by gp.common_id

SELECT gp.name as name,gp.person_num as personNum,gp.common_id as commonId,gd.price_ori as priceOri, gd.price as price,gc.common_image as commonImage,gc.common_name as commonName,gd.goods_id as goodsId, gp.start_time as startTime,gp.end_time as endTime FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp LEFT JOIN (SELECT min( d.price ) AS price, d.price_ori, d.goods_id, d.common_id, d.pintuan_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail d LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together t on d.pintuan_id = t.pintuan_id WHERE t.`status` = 1 GROUP BY d.common_id ) as gd ON gp.pintuan_id = gd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gp.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE 1=1 and gp.status = 1 and end_time > now() and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.is_delete = 0
and gp.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.goods_type <> 3
group by gd.common_id
